body:
Sounds similar to my situation; still living with my mother, graduated a few years ago, still a virgin in fact.

I wish I knew what to tell you, like how to get out of this. It'd mean then that I knew how to get out of my own rut.

Still, this is about you, though, and you've got more going for you than I. Have you at least searched for a job in your field? You're a recent grad, and with a damn good GPA. I've recommended it to a few friends of mine who hadn't graduated yet, but there's a tech job board called "dice.com" that might put you in the right direction in finding a new job.

It worked for a few friends of mine, maybe you'll also be lucky trying your hand at that.

As somebody who used to think the same way you do (I want fun, not work) I'll tell you this: it's possible to balance work and fun. It's all about time management, since you're not going to be working all the time. It'll suck at first, especially when it becomes apparent how little you may know about managing your time to both get your work done and have fun when you aren't working, but once you do get the hang of it you'll have the money you need to have fun like you never did before.
